why: THE CANVAS, LOCALLY (P6.d). Every figure is a value the vetted read tools returned on 2026-09-20; the blocks, arrangement, prose and questions are the session's. NO MODEL TURN WAS SPENT. This is what the room draws from the vocabulary; whether Bob composes it is the next live turn's to answer.
question: how are our stores?
answer:
The shops are **fine, and the week-on-week headline is one Monday.**

All but Rockwell came back from August; what separates them now is the basket.

blocks.question: The week, day by day, against the same day before.
blocks.claim: Six of seven days ahead; the one behind is a Monday
blocks.thought: against a Monday, a week earlier, that took nearly double

blocks.question: Every shop, week by week, over the month.
blocks.claim: The same two bad weeks on all seven; one has not come back
blocks.thought: the one that did not come back

blocks.question: Who is up and who is down this week.
blocks.thought: the one materially down — and its whole fall is that Monday

blocks.question: And what a visit is worth.
blocks.claim: This is where the shops actually differ
blocks.thought: busier tills, smaller baskets — the one to act on

children.say: What separates the shops now is not how many come in but what each visit is worth.

reading.claim: fine, and the week-on-week headline is one Monday
reading.caveat: The comparison is the closed week against the one before, each day against the same weekday.
reading.next:
Set a watch on Greenhills' basket, so it only speaks if the shrink continues — I'd backtest it over the last month first and you switch it on from the inbox.

Fairview is the opposite case and needs nothing: fewer people, each spending more, which is a shop doing its job with a smaller crowd. I'd ask the manager whether the crowd is the mall or the shop before calling it a trend.

Rockwell: open it. Every other shop closed its August gap when the month turned; Rockwell's is still open, and a read cannot tell me why. That is a question for whoever was on the floor in the last week of August.
asks: Is Fairview's smaller crowd a trend?
